field_text_formatted.value: Nuxt 2 is end of life, so it is a fair question. Druxt had years of improvements and fixes sitting unreleased, and I would rather finish them than carry them across half done. 0.25.0 gets that work out, and gives the 2.0.0 port a stable, fast baseline to start from. Get it right on the stack it runs on today, then upgrade, then add new features, then polish.
